title: threeFactor engine config
description: Sparse deviations from registry defaults. The execution list is the algorithm order, validated against unit consumes/produces at load. Default config = frozen dev72 behavior.

execution.description: Full unit order; omit to inherit the default order.

badges.description: Badge-family detection (aspect/dark-interior/size gates) plus dark-plate glyph recovery.

badgeAspectMin.description: minimum aspect ratio for bright badge candidates (was BADGE_ASPECT_MIN)

badgeAspectMax.description: maximum aspect ratio for bright badge candidates (was BADGE_ASPECT_MAX)

badgeDarkInteriorMin.description: minimum dark pixel fraction for badge interior (was BADGE_DARK_INTERIOR_MIN)

badgeSizeTolFactor.description: size tolerance for badge family clustering, in linear space; Math.log(...) is applied at the anchoredFamilies use site (was BADGE_SIZE_TOL = Math.log(1.15), per merge note 4)

plateMinWidth.description: minimum width for dark-plate badge recovery candidates

plateMaxWidth.description: maximum width for dark-plate badge recovery candidates

plateMinHeight.description: minimum height for dark-plate badge recovery candidates

plateMaxHeight.description: maximum height for dark-plate badge recovery candidates

plateAspectMin.description: minimum aspect ratio for dark-plate candidates

plateAspectMax.description: maximum aspect ratio for dark-plate candidates

plateFillMin.description: minimum fill fraction (area/bbox) for dark-plate candidates

plateInteriorMargin.description: pixel margin for interior glyph fraction measurement (coincidentally also 4, but a distinct knob from plateBboxMargin)

plateGlyphFractionMin.description: minimum bright pixel fraction in plate interior

plateGlyphFractionMax.description: maximum bright pixel fraction in plate interior

plateProximityThreshold.description: distance threshold: a dark-plate candidate must not be near an already-accepted bright badge

plateBboxMargin.description: margin for expanding the dark-plate badge bounding box (coincidentally also 4, but a distinct knob from plateInteriorMargin)

badgeInsidePadding.description: padding (px) around a badge bbox for the tee-candidate exclusion test in measure.ts makeTees; the rejection reason string is templated from this value (was hard-coded "+3px pad" — see file header)

digits.description: Badge digit segmentation (noise/height/wide-merge gates) and canonical digit-mask normalization.

minComponentArea.description: minimum pixel area for a connected component to be a digit candidate (was MIN_COMPONENT_AREA)

heightRatioMin.description: minimum height, as a fraction of the tallest surviving component, for a digit candidate (was HEIGHT_RATIO_MIN)

wideRatio.description: width-to-height ratio threshold for detecting a merged (touching) digit pair (was WIDE_RATIO)

valleySearchLo.description: lower bound (fraction of width) for the interior valley-search window (was VALLEY_SEARCH_LO); see file header — an inverted pair vs. valleySearchHi is safe, not corrupting

valleySearchHi.description: upper bound (fraction of width) for the interior valley-search window (was VALLEY_SEARCH_HI); see file header — an inverted pair vs. valleySearchLo is safe, not corrupting

digitW.description: normalized digit mask width fed to the trained classifier (was DIGIT_W) — see file header on the model coupling

digitH.description: normalized digit mask height fed to the trained classifier (was DIGIT_H) — see file header on the model coupling

sprite.description: Basket matched-filter sprite detection: coarse scan, stride-1 refinement, matching-pursuit dedupe.

coarseStride.description: pixel stride for the coarse sprite-matching scan pass (was SPRITE_COARSE_STRIDE)

coarseThreshold.description: score threshold for coarse sprite-matching peaks (was SPRITE_COARSE_THRESHOLD)

scoreMin.description: minimum score for final sprite match acceptance, after refinement (was DEFAULT_SPRITE_SCORE_MIN; coincidentally also g5.zfit.alignedWorstCeiling's value — see file header, unrelated)

tipOffset.description: offset from basket center to the pole-tip annotation point (was BASKET_TIP_OFFSET)

coarseGateYOffset.description: y offset (from the sprite top) used by the cheap coarse-pass bright-pixel gate

coarseGateXOffset.description: x offset (±) used by the cheap coarse-pass bright-pixel gate

refinementRadius.description: stride-1 search radius around each coarse peak during refinement (missed by the original inventory sweep)

staleScoreEpsilon.description: minimum score drop, versus the live (partially-erased) mask, before a matching-pursuit candidate is treated as stale and re-scored (missed by the original inventory sweep)

spriteWidth.description: reported basket bbox width — see file header on the coupling to the basket-sprite.json asset

spriteHeight.description: reported basket bbox height — see file header on the coupling to the basket-sprite.json asset

cleanBasketFamily.description: Refine baseline basket matches to intact renderer-family members using basket-shape white coverage plus a coherent local dark shell.

bboxTolerancePx.description: allowed difference between the bright component bbox and the 42x66 renderer-family bbox

positionTolerancePx.description: maximum top-left displacement between a baseline sprite match and its bright connected component

areaRatioMin.description: minimum connected bright-component area divided by the basket template white-pixel count

areaRatioMax.description: maximum connected bright-component area divided by the basket template white-pixel count

whiteCoverageMin.description: minimum fraction of expected basket-shape white pixels owned by the matched bright component; bbox-off pixels are ignored

shellRadiusPx.description: 8-neighbor dilation radius used to form the local shell around the actual bright basket component shape

darkShellMin.description: minimum fraction of the shape-local shell occupied by dark-mask pixels

darkCoherenceMin.description: minimum fraction of dark shell pixels belonging to one connected dark component

phantomTee.description: C01 complete-occlusion fallback: synthesize a missing tee at the predecessor hole's assigned basket tip.

minViableScore.description: a hole whose best assignment score is at or below this counts as tee-less

endpoints.description: Enclosed-hole tee-ring detection plus the bright-component fallback tier.

holeAreaMin.description: minimum enclosed dark hole area for tee detection (was HOLE_AREA_MIN)

holeAreaMax.description: maximum enclosed dark hole area for tee detection (was HOLE_AREA_MAX)

holeDimMax.description: maximum hole bbox dimension, width or height (was HOLE_DIM_MAX)

ringBand.description: ring band width (px) for bright-fraction measurement around the hole, and the dilation radius used to grow it (was RING_BAND)

ringFracMin.description: minimum bright fraction in the enclosing ring band (was RING_FRAC_MIN)

dilationRadii.description: dilation radii for the multi-scale hole detection passes; detections merge across radii, preferring the smallest

largeRadiiThreshold.description: dilation radius at/above which the coarser (largeRadiiAreaMin) hole-area floor applies instead of holeAreaMin (missed by the original inventory sweep — only the resulting area floor, 40, was recorded, not this threshold)

largeRadiiAreaMin.description: minimum hole area required for the larger dilation radii (radius >= largeRadiiThreshold)

ringMergeProximity.description: distance threshold for merging ring detections found at different dilation radii

elongationThreshold.description: principal-axis elongation ratio threshold distinguishing tee-rect from diamond (near-square) hole shape

componentMinDim.description: minimum component width or height for the bright-component tee fallback tier

componentMaxDim.description: maximum component width or height for the bright-component tee fallback tier

componentMinArea.description: minimum component area for the bright-component tee fallback tier

componentMaxArea.description: maximum component area for the bright-component tee fallback tier

componentMinFill.description: minimum component fill (area/bbox) for the bright-component tee fallback tier

componentMaxFill.description: maximum component fill (area/bbox) for the bright-component tee fallback tier

teeRingDedupDistance.description: distance threshold excluding a component-tee candidate near an already-accepted ring-tee (coincidentally also 12, but distinct from g4.scoring.ringTolerance — see file header)

teeSpriteExclusionDistance.description: distance threshold excluding a component-tee candidate near a matched basket-sprite center

teeFamily.description: LAB intact tee-family refinement: keep only the largest mutually-consistent ring-tee family by enclosing-frame major/minor/area (frameForRing + selectTeeFamily, courseSweep.ts). Component/recovered tee tiers pass through untouched.

frameAreaMin.description: minimum enclosing bright-component area to count as a frame candidate (LAB: area >= 10)

frameAreaMax.description: maximum enclosing bright-component area to count as a frame candidate (LAB: area <= 500)

majorRatioToleranceFactor.description: a family member's frame major must satisfy |log(f.major/s.major)| <= log(this) vs the anchor frame (LAB: log(1.25))

minorRatioToleranceFactor.description: same tolerance, applied to frame minor (LAB: log(1.25))

areaRatioToleranceFactor.description: same tolerance, applied to frame area (LAB: log(1.5))

scoring.description: Tee-badge-basket pair scoring geometry: zone/ring proximity, orientation, collinearity, basket identity.

fallbackTeeBboxOffset.description: fallback tee bbox half-size when no ring/component geometry exists (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee, measure.ts makeTees)

fallbackTeeBboxSize.description: fallback tee bbox dimension (size x size) when no ring/component geometry exists (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee, measure.ts makeTees)

ringDistance.description: basket-to-tee ring membership distance (shared: assignment.ts recoveredTee onRing, measure.ts makeTees onRing, scoring.ts zoneFactor primary ring)

ringTolerance.description: tolerance band around ringDistance for the basket-to-tee ring check (shared: assignment.ts, measure.ts, scoring.ts)

zoneFactorDistance.description: close-proximity threshold for the zone factor penalty around a non-owning basket

secondaryRingDistance.description: secondary ring distance for the zone factor radial check

secondaryRingTolerance.description: tolerance band around secondaryRingDistance for the zone factor radial check

radialTolerance.description: radial alignment fraction threshold for the zone factor penalty

teeOrientationSigma.description: gaussian sigma (degrees) for the tee-to-badge angle penalty

badgeFractionTarget.description: optimal fractional position of the badge along the tee-basket chord

badgeFractionTolerance.description: acceptable deviation from badgeFractionTarget before the fraction penalty kicks in

badgeFractionSigma.description: gaussian sigma for the badge-fraction penalty

collinearityWeight.description: upward factor for the collinearity bonus

collinearitySigma.description: gaussian sigma (degrees) for the collinearity angle penalty

basketIdentityFloor.description: minimum score factor for the basket identity prior

basketScoreOffset.description: offset subtracted from basket.score in the basket identity calculation

basketScoreScale.description: divisor for basket.score normalization in the basket identity calculation

endpointSupportSampleCount.description: number of trailing leg-path points averaged for RawPairEvidence.endpointSupportTee/endpointSupportBasket (missed by the per-cluster over-report re-scans; caught in the phase-3 sign-off sweep)

badgeOverlapWaiverRadius.description: distance (field cells) from the badge center within which a leg point is exempt from the tee/basket path-overlap penalty (missed by the per-cluster over-report re-scans; caught in the phase-3 sign-off sweep)

recoveredTeePrior.description: confidence discount applied to a pair score when the tee is a recovered (synthesized) tee rather than a directly-detected one (missed by the per-cluster over-report re-scans; caught in the phase-3 sign-off sweep)

minWindowCells.description: minimum window size (field cells) for the weakWindow sliding-window worst-case score, shared by zfitFactor/makeRawPairEvidence/scorePair (missed by the per-cluster over-report re-scans; caught in the phase-3 sign-off sweep)

search.description: Assignment local search: candidate-row windows, pairwise exchange passes, recovered-tee dedupe.

assignTopRows.description: window size (top-N by score) of candidate pairs per badge kept for the search (was ASSIGN_TOP_ROWS)

exchangeTopK.description: top-k limit per badge for pairwise exchange optimization (was EXCHANGE_TOP_K)

maxAssignPasses.description: iteration limit for the assignment optimization loop (was MAX_ASSIGN_PASSES)

recoveredTeeDedupeDistance.description: minimum separation (px) between a recovered tee and an existing tee before it is dropped as a duplicate

fourLaneSensor.description: Four-lane ribbon cross-section sensor: paired/one-sided rails plus corridor-interior evidence with known occluders treated as UNKNOWN.

edgeDeltaPx.description: normal-distance offset on each side of an expected rail used for inside-vs-outside grayscale lift

liftReference.description: inside-minus-outside grayscale lift that maps to score 1.0

tangentHalfPx.description: half-length in source pixels sampled along the tangent for each band observation

tangentSamples.description: number of uniformly spaced tangent samples per band; majority-blocked means UNKNOWN

zfit.description: Z-shaped route salvage for top-K assignment rows whose corridor support is weak.

topK.description: assignment rows eligible for the salvage re-score (was ZFIT_TOP_K)

alignedWorstCeiling.description: skip salvage when the aligned worst-window support is already at/above this (also the zfitFactor early-return ceiling — same check, same value)

distanceStartOffset.description: pixel offset past the first leg length where zfit waypoint search begins

distanceStepPx.description: spacing between successive waypoint distances tried in the zfit search

maxChordFraction.description: maximum detour ratio (of the tee-basket chord) allowed in zfit path search

maxAdditionalDistance.description: maximum extra distance beyond the first leg for zfit waypoint searches

bendAngles.description: bend angle samples (degrees) tried at each zfit waypoint

bendLengthShort.description: shortest bend-segment length, as a multiple of corridor width, tried at each non-zero bend angle

bendLengthMedium.description: middle bend-segment length, as a multiple of corridor width, tried at each non-zero bend angle

bendLengthLong.description: longest bend-segment length, as a multiple of corridor width, tried at each non-zero bend angle

maxPathOvershootFraction.description: maximum total bent-path length, as a multiple of the direct tee-basket chord, before a candidate waypoint/bend is rejected (missed by the original inventory sweep)

bendFactorWithSegment.description: score multiplier when the bent path has a non-zero second segment

bendFactorWithoutSegment.description: score multiplier when the bent path has no second segment (angle bends immediately into the basket leg)

scoreMultiplier.description: final multiplier applied to every zfit candidate score, on top of the bend factor

ribbon.description: Support-field construction (blur, gradient ribbon sampling, normalization) and badge-occlusion patching.

fieldScale.description: support-field downsampling scale factor (was measure.ts DEFAULT_FIELD_SCALE; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

supportTau.description: support-field gradient percentile threshold (was measure.ts DEFAULT_SUPPORT_TAU; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

gaussianSigma.description: sigma for the initial gaussian blur of the support field (was GAUSSIAN_SIGMA)

blurRadiusSigmas.description: blur kernel radius, as a multiple of gaussianSigma (missed by the original inventory sweep: a THIRD distinct literal "4" in this file, alongside gradientDeltaMultiplier and costMultiplier)

gradientDeltaMultiplier.description: multiplier scaling ribbon half-width for edge-difference (gradient) sampling — coincidentally also 4, but a distinct knob from blurRadiusSigmas/costMultiplier

normalizationPercentile.description: percentile of raw support magnitude used for normalization

supportGamma.description: gamma exponent for support-field power normalization

costMultiplier.description: multiplicative boost to unsupported regions in the routing cost field — coincidentally also 4, but a distinct knob from gradientDeltaMultiplier/blurRadiusSigmas

haloSupportThreshold.description: support level capped for cells under a badge (halo occlusion) — separate from patchAcceptanceThreshold despite the same value

patchReachMargin.description: pixel margin added to badge half-width for patch-search expansion

sampleOffsetPx.description: symmetric inner/outer offset from ribbon half-width for edge-patch orientation sampling (one knob: the code uses the same value on both sides, half-2.5 and half+2.5)

patchOrientations.description: number of angles sampled when testing badge-edge patching

centerOuterGrayMargin.description: grayscale difference threshold used to reject a badge-edge patch candidate

liftThreshold.description: grayscale lift (inner-outer difference) that normalizes to a full-strength patch score

patchAcceptanceThreshold.description: minimum patch score (from liftThreshold normalization) before a cell is patched at all (missed by the original inventory sweep — coincidentally also 0.5, but a distinct knob from haloSupportThreshold)

patchedCellSupportCap.description: maximum support value assigned to a patched cell

haloBboxMargin.description: pixel margin expanding a badge bbox for the halo-capping scan (missed by the original inventory sweep; distinct from insideBadgeMargin and from patchReachMargin)

insideBadgeMargin.description: pixel margin used by the "is this point inside a badge" occlusion test during patch search (missed by the original inventory sweep; distinct from haloBboxMargin)

routing.description: Bucketed-priority-queue pathfinding geometry plus the corridor/route-search parameters.

quantum.description: distance quantum (bucket width) for the bucketed priority queue in pathfinding (was QUANTUM)

ring.description: ring buffer size (bucket count) for the pathfinding queue (was RING); see validateRoutingRingQuantum for the cross-feature relationship to quantum and ribbon.costMultiplier

seedCostClamp.description: local cost cap applied to the seed neighborhood in pathfinding

seedClampRadiusCells.description: radius (field cells) of the seed neighborhood that gets seedCostClamp applied (missed by the original inventory sweep — only the clamp value was recorded, not this radius)

corridorWidthPx.description: corridor width in pixels for leg search (was measure.ts DEFAULT_CORRIDOR_WIDTH; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

orientations.description: number of angle orientations sampled for routing (was measure.ts DEFAULT_ORIENTATIONS; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

widthsSrc.description: width scales for tee-to-tee leg routing (was measure.ts DEFAULT_WIDTHS_SRC; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

alignmentPower.description: alignment weighting power for routing (was measure.ts DEFAULT_ALIGNMENT_POWER; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

worstWindowSrcPx.description: worst-case search window size in pixels (was measure.ts DEFAULT_WORST_WINDOW; rides CorridorParams, see file header)

hsv.description: Bright/dark pixel-mask HSV thresholds feeding every downstream gate.

brightVMin.description: minimum V (brightness) for bright-pixel classification (was BRIGHT_V_MIN)

brightSMax.description: maximum S (saturation — colorfulness) for bright-pixel classification (was BRIGHT_S_MAX); coincidentally also 45, but a different HSV axis from darkVMax — see file header

darkVMax.description: maximum V (brightness) for dark-pixel classification (was DARK_V_MAX); coincidentally also 45, but a different HSV axis from brightSMax — see file header
